newsitem.title: CHILE: SOCCER-CHILEAN FORWARD ROZENTAL TO BE SOLD TO GLASGOW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHILEAN FORWARD ROZENTAL TO BE SOLD TO GLASGOW.

text.p: Chile's Universidad Catolica and Glasgow Rangers have closed a deal to transfer Catolica's star forward Sebastian Rozental to the Scottish club, the player and his club said Wednesday.
The $6.3 million deal has yet to be signed but negotiations are finished and Rozental will travel to Scotland to wrap up the deal before Christmas, club officials said.
"We've absolutely reached an agreement," said Universidad Catolica president Manuel Velez.
Rozental, 20, was the second-highest scorer in the Chilean championship which just ended, in which Universidad Catolica finished second.
